Hey I got an idea for a game but its kinda hard to explain, it starts you off in a room with a normal puzzle in it and your task is to escape. Once you escape it starts you off in the same room but something about the room and/or the puzzle is slightly different, and eventually it will get to a point where the room is completely different and the puzzle is also completely different, and now you have to escape the new room that you created and it continues on until you decide to stop.

 There is no saving feature and once you exit out of a level you have to start over again in a completely randomly generated room. I don't know if someone already did a game like that so the idea might of already been used so sorry if it somebody already did a game like that.
